_about: The city biome's brief as data (Claude C, lane C, 21 Oct): built ground, built edges and lit streets for the shared kit (rules-system.md 2 and 4; the harbour is the kit's second proof, for built edges). Palette intent names house ramps (art/house-palette.json) and tones 0 to 5, never RGB. Edge sets name the cliff core's EDGE_SETS or are marked proposed. to-all-clean holds: paving reads as calm fields with few, large joints, not a grid of pixels; detail sits at height changes and doors. Status 'brief' until Claude A's kit cut pins a version.
references: Compare at the same character height with Eastward's town screens (edges and the soft grid: Eastward only, Matt 21 Oct 09:23). Never commit their screenshots.

setts.note: granite setts in courses of broken bond, a field of one tone with the courses as long soft lines; worn a tone paler down the middle of a lane

flags.note: pavement flags 9 to 15 long, joints a tone down (not ink), one cracked or sunk now and then, never every slab

asphalt.note: new town roads: calm patches, square repairs with a crisp edge, two wheel tracks a tone lighter

kerb.note: 2 px of long granite: lit top, the face to the road a tone down, the gutter darker

ashlar_wall.note: the cliff core's city bands: dressed courses under a coping (EDGE_SETS.city)

brick_wall.note: weathered town brick: soot high up, stock repairs, repointing, salt bloom low down, weep holes (weathered.py, on main)

plaster_front.note: house fronts: one calm colour per house, the light on the west jamb of every opening

roofs.note: slate ridges for the old town, tile (clay) for adobe and warm towns; roofs run back from the fronts (to-all-volume 2)

iron.note: railings, lamp posts, covers, rails: thin, lit on the upper edge only

brass_copper.note: brass fittings and verdigris copper domes (the old town's market hall and clock)

lamplight.note: the warm point at night: windows and street lamps; pools of light on paving one tone up in lamp's ramp, finite in number per screen

neon.note: new town signs only, a few per screen; glow is a one-cell halo, never a gradient fog

street_water.note: the Glint's channel and the ria at the quay: calm, darker in a band under walls where their reflection lies

ground._about: Ground recipes by kind. Built ground is laid, so its pattern is the courses, kept long and calm; dressing is weeds in joints, litter by doors and under benches, never speckle.

dressing: a manhole or gully by the kerb
tram rails in a band of setts (old town lines)

square.material: setts in a fan or flags round a fountain or statue

dressing: a bed of flowers in clumps
garden.note: parks and the Heights' gardens: the meadow ground recipe inside a kerb

plants.where: setts' and flags' joints, wall feet
plants.note: in a few joints together, along walls more than mid-street
plane or lime: a round crown casting a two-tone shadow on the paving
the cliff core's ivy piece (BIOMES.city ivy 0.12)

tiers.note: the city's retaining walls are 40 high (cliff core BIOMES.city face 40); stair streets climb them in a few broad flights with landings; no ramps (eastward-edges 6.3)

city.shapes: dressed courses under a coping, a 2 px foot, a rock stair

brick_retaining.where: old town walls where brick, not ashlar (the mill town's brick is its own edge set in mill_town.json)
brick_retaining.shapes: 40 px weathered brick with pilasters every 64 to 96 px, coping, weep holes, soot and salt by height

railing_rim.shapes: an iron railing along a top's rim that stops walkers: rail lit on top, balusters every 3 px, a post every 18; its shadow a tone down on the coping

quay_wall.where: where a town tier meets the water

kerb.shapes: a 2 px granite line between pavement and road, no height change, no outline

channel.shapes: a stone-lined channel: lit copings on both banks, the channel walls' dark faces inside them

water.channel: the Glint in its stone channel, quick: streaks along the flow, darker under the west wall
water.falls: the cliff core's neutral fall down a wall: white only where it tips over the lip and churns at the foot, the wall beside it wet a tone down; no noise of streaks
water.harbour: the ria at the quay: a calm plane in lagoon's deep tones, the wall's reflection as broken horizontal strokes
water.fountains: a basin with a coping, a single jet as a few tone-5 pixels and rings on the water, finite

proposed.shop_front: a door with a step, a sandwich board, a crate of goods, a bike against the wall
proposed.tram_stop: a shelter, a timetable board, a bench, a lamp
proposed.night_stall: an awning, a lit lantern, a counter of bowls, two stools (variant new_town)

night: lit windows, about one in three, never all
neon hum only near signs (new town)
darker than the countryside between lamps
ambience.light: upper-left sun; fronts throw their shadow down and right across the street, two tones down on paving

transitions._about: This biome's side of each meeting in the block-out, for Claude G's scripts/art/biomes/transitions.json.

coast.edge: the quay wall: setts on top, the sea below (coast.sea_wall)

meadow.middle: town edge gardens: setts give way to a gravel lane, then a hedge and meadow over 120 px
meadow.where: towns' edges toward the valley and the Lull plain (claude-e, claude-i, claude-h)

river.edge: the channel or a quay on the river; towpath gravel as the middle
river.where: the Lull at Lullford and Neon (claude-i)

canyon.middle: packed dust and adobe rubble: the town's street runs into the canyon's track

mill_town.edge: none in the block-out: Cogsworth's box has no city meeting (h-to-c-1445); if the Lull towns ever touch, the seam is a gravel lane between the two pavings

variants._about: One biome, several towns: the same edge sets and paving, each with its own mix of fronts, roofs and lights. Cogsworth's mill town is its own biome, mill_town.json (Claude H, #201), not a variant here: a brick edge set inside city would be the city's shapes in another colour, which check_biomes refuses.

old_town.fronts: plaster and ashlar, slate ridges, window boxes

new_town.fronts: concrete and panel, flat roofs with rooftop things, neon signs a few per screen

adobe_town.fronts: adobe and clay tile, awnings, flat roofs with ladders
